title: Morning Intel
bullets: Markets: S&P 500, Dow and Nasdaq each rose ~0.2% Wed with broad gains across sectors after Treasury moved to steady the bond market
Yields: 30-yr Treasury fell ~10bps to 5.19% (biggest 1-day drop in a year) after Treasury doubled long-bond buybacks to $4B/operation; 10-yr eased to 4.65%
Gold/Oil/Crypto: Gold hit its highest since May near $4,569 on falling yields; oil held near $85/bbl on a 4th day of gains; bitcoin rose as Trump pushed Congress on a crypto bill
Biotech: Moderna nearly tripled and Merck surged on positive late-stage mRNA melanoma vaccine data; the XBI biotech ETF jumped ~6%
Retail: TJX, Target and Lowe's Q2 earnings lifted retail stocks broadly
Policy: Fed's July minutes show a deepening divide - many officials said rate hikes could be needed if inflation doesn't decline
Companies: Meta's landmark social-media harm trial began in federal court in Oakland
Ahead: Weekly jobless claims and leading indicators due Thu; Walmart and Alibaba report earnings
